# SOP-P2-L1-04 Shift handover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Control room operator confirms line status and communicates open work orders for EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03.  
   1.2. Verify no active maintenance is in progress that would prevent normal handover. Refer to MM-P2-L1-SB03 for maintenance isolation record requirements.

2. Incoming/outgoing communication
   2.1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator on operational state, process faults, and any deviation noted on QS-PROC-06.  
   2.2. Document exceptions on shift log and attach any relevant measurement printouts.

3. Critical equipment checks (to be walked with incoming operator)
   3.1. EQ-P2-L1-IH02: Confirm induction heater instrumentation readings are in range and cooling systems are verified. The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min.  
   3.2. EQ-P2-L1-SB03: Inspect shot blast cabinet access panels and fasteners. The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 50 N·m.  
   3.3. EQ-P2-L1-RR01: Confirm roller runout and part transfer confirmation to receiving station.

4. PPE
   4.1. Ensure incoming operator confirms use of required PPE for Hot Forge line per site policy and SOP-P2-L1-02 before entering production area.

5. Special notes
   5.1. Any safety or quality events observed during shift must be escalated immediately and recorded against the associated equipment tag. Refer to QS-PROC-06 for nonconformance reporting.

6. Documentation and sign-off
   6.1. Both incoming and outgoing operators must sign handover log with time, name, and brief summary of line state. 6.2. Attach any maintenance permits or isolation records as required by MM-P2-L1-SB03 and SOP-P2-L1-02.

Related documents: MM-P2-L1-SB03, QS-PROC-06, SOP-P2-L1-02
